doctrine: feature_list.json — harness primitive (adopted v106, merged across parallel waves). One active feature at a time. No feature is done without evidence (command + measured result). Status values: done | in_progress | todo | blocked | owner-gated. dependencies = feature ids that must be done first. The Task-19 parallel wave's kernel lineage rows (feat-001..006) live in git history (01a144e) — the measured economy rows below are this ledger's source of truth; do not import rows without evidence.
rules: evidence-or-it-did-not-happen: every done carries a runnable proof string
no-secrets-in-artifacts: evidence strings never contain key material
scope-gate: new work = new feature row first; never rewrite rows to hide unfinished work
sibling-waves: git pull --rebase before every push; the parallel lineage (Task 18/19) is real and its BLOC-STATE map is the one language map
